title: I Asked My Cab Driver To Take Me Anywhere. He Took Me to His Past.
description:
TIP OUR DRIVERS! https://linktr.ee/ktmrshow

TAKE ME TO YOUR FAVORITE SPOT AND KEEP THE METER RUNNING! Kareem hails a New York City yellow cab and meets Young, a cab driver from South Korea whose lifelong love of mountains, art, and quiet observation has shaped the way he sees the world. Instead of taking Kareem to a neighborhood restaurant or hidden city gem, Young invites him to leave New York behind and spend the day exploring Bear Mountain, where the two hike scenic trails, sketch landscapes, and search for a little peace just an hour outside Manhattan.

Along the way, Young reflects on immigrating to America more than twenty years ago after growing up watching American movies and television from Seoul. He shares how he built a career handcrafting Korean storefront signs before the pandemic led him to driving a taxi, why he still believes he's chasing the American Dream, and how losing his wife changed the way he experiences the world. What begins as a trip into nature becomes a conversation about grief, optimism, creativity, and finding beauty in the smallest details of everyday life.

The day takes an unexpected turn when Kareem and Young meet a lifelong fisherman at the lake, leading to Young catching the very first fish of his life. Between quiet moments in the woods, heartfelt conversations, and the excitement of trying something new, Kareem discovers that sometimes the best journeys aren't about where you're going, but about slowing down long enough to appreciate the people and places along the way.

Keep The Meter Running is a YouTube series created and hosted by Kareem Rahma. In each episode, Kareem asks a driver to take him to their favorite place and keeps the meter running the whole time.
